executive_summary: The v5 rating chain is sound and should not be touched: 25 Elo per point (OLS slope 1.035 [0.974,1.097], big-favorite bins calibrated 0.98-1.03), nfelo's QB term (-0.113 MAE OOS [-0.209,-0.019], n=1139) and the team-total identity (beats every fitted split by 0.014-0.020 MAE, rolling-origin n=4363) all survive their critics. Every theory that claimed an edge against the closing line failed out of sample: a rating-based number sits ~1.7 pts from the close, is 0.24 MAE worse (nfelo, a lower bound because nfelo ingests prior closes and PFF; a results-only Elo loses 0.37-0.43), and has been 49.5% ATS vs the close since 2022, so the engine is a pricing tool and its outputs must be labeled that way. The largest fixable error is the totals engine: the spec's 46.0 + 0.35*ratings runs +1.32 pts high and scores 10.82 MAE in 2022-25 (n=1087) against 10.19 for the close; the reconciled formula (prior-season mean blended in-season with K=128 minus a 0.5 median target, Week-1 prior -1.0, team scoring rates 0.30, QB 0.72, mean-preserving divisional -0.85/+0.45, environment table) scores 10.31 (dMAE vs close +0.12 [-0.02,+0.26], O/U 50.7%). The spec's pace (+/-1..2), rain, <32F and rest/TNF terms have no OOS value (the pace rule costs +0.04 to +0.08 MAE) and go to zero; wind is linear at -0.18/mph from ~8 mph (stadium-FE slope -0.21, se 0.05) and domes are +2.0 (FE +2.15, se 0.52). On spreads, the as-built PFF/Cole site HFA (hfa_mod + tz)/25 is a composite that embeds nfelo's bye, divisional and surface mods, counts the time-zone term twice and carries 1.3 pts SD of per-game noise: replace it with a constant 1.75 (1.5-2.0 are within 0.01 MAE; 2.5 costs +0.049 [+0.004,+0.096]), strip nfelo's bye mods and price rest once at the market's -0.15/day (bye = 1.05 pts; the build currently carries 1.2-1.8), and delete the short-week, bye and west-to-east clauses. The QB starter-to-backup adjustment must be applied net of what each input already embeds (nfelo carries 2.36 pts at a first backup start vs 2.66 market-implied); the flat -2..-4.5 on top would overshoot by 2-4.5 pts on ~7% of games, so use a stint table 2.5/1.5/0.5 and never apply it to planned offseason starters. Team totals stay on the identity with the matchup reallocation block set to 0 (cap +/-0.5, mirrored into the spread), because every reallocation tested is noise costing +0.02 to +0.09 MAE. Confidence tags should measure distance to the market as expected excess RMSE sqrt(BASE^2 + D^2) - BASE (BASE 12.65 spread / 13.1 total), not inter-engine SD, which predicts nothing (market |err| slope on disagreement -0.004, p=0.98), and only ~27% of an origin-vs-market gap is real (lambda 0.273, se 0.089). Untestable locally and left open: PFF/Cole history (blend weights, clamp anchor, W1 dispersion, totals), non-QB injuries, forecast vs realized weather, the rested-starter discount (~9 pts, n=20-35), and the structural fact that nfelo is market- and PFF-informed, so the 0.46/0.39 blend double-counts PFF and engine agreement is not edge.

changes.area: Totals engine: level, slope, team scoring rates, QB term, divisional term
changes.change: Replace implied_total = 46.0 + 0.35*(rating_home + rating_away) with a leak-free league prior blended in-season (minus a 0.5 median target, Week 1 -1.0), a team scoring-rate term, nfelo's QB term on the nfelo path, and ONE mean-preserving divisional term. This reconciles the totals expert (V3), the HFA expert's divisional-totals finding, the market critic's median-target finding and the early-season expert's Week-1 prior into a single formula so the divisional and level effects are counted once.
changes.parameter_spec: L_prev = prior-season REG realized mean total (2026: 46.0; 2025 realized 45.96). Weeks 2+: LG = (128*L_prev + n*L_ytd)/(128+n) - 0.5, n = REG games already played this season, L_ytd = their mean total (K=128-256 equivalent). Week 1: LG = L_prev - 1.0. nfelo path (QB-free starting Elo, R = (Elo-1505)/25): T = LG + 0.10*(R_h + R_a) + 0.30*GT_dev + 0.72*QB_sum + DIV + ENV. PFF/Cole paths (QB-adjusted ratings, no history): T = LG + 0.30*(R_h + R_a) + DIV + ENV (0.35 is statistically equivalent; do NOT add QB_sum to QB-adjusted ratings). GT_dev = gt_h + gt_a - 2*(LG + 0.5), gt_t = (K*prior-season mean game total of team t + gp*season-to-date mean)/(K+gp), K=3 (1-6 equivalent). QB_sum = (home_538_qb_adj + away_538_qb_adj)/25 from nfelo_games.csv. DIV = -0.85 if div_game else +0.45 (mean-preserving at the 35-37% divisional share; replaces V3's -1.36/0 and the HFA critic's -0.75/+0.40). ENV per change 2. Totals blend weights (PFF .38 / nfelo .32 / Cole .30) unchanged. No rest, bye, short-week, week-of-season, late-season, neutral, grass or TNF terms. Rounding half-up unchanged.

Rolling-origin drop-one 2016-25 n=2639 (totals critic): QB +0.094 [+0.052,+0.136], scoring rates +0.111 [+0.028,+0.196], Elo +0.008 [-0.004,+0.019]; Wald pf=pa p=0.41 so one 0.30 term. Level (synthesis 03, total = L + 0.30*elo, no fitting): in-season blend vs prior-season mean -0.048 [-0.089,-0.009] 2010-21 (n=2810) and -0.045 [-0.090,-0.004] 2022-25; blend - 0.5: -0.062 [-0.104,-0.022] and -0.068 [-0.123,-0.015]; prior-season CLOSE mean as prior is worse in 2022-25 (+0.076 [+0.024,+0.126]); realized mean exceeds the median by +0.79/season 2009-25 (+1.16 in 2022-25). Week 1 (synthesis 06, n=239 2010-25): base bias -0.72 (se 0.88), median -2.32; shift -1.0 dMAE -0.076 [-0.200,+0.053] (2022-25 n=64: -0.253 [-0.500,-0.005]; 2010-21: -0.012); early-season critic: W1 dip is W1-specific (W2 -0.50, W3 -0.15, W4 +0.96), fixed shift improves rolling W1 MAE in every window 2005-25 (-0.126 [-0.24,-0.02]).
changes.expected_impact: -0.5 MAE vs the current spec (10.82 -> 10.31) and removal of the +1.3-pt level bias; the number lands ~0.1 pt/game worse than the close with ~50% O/U. Order of value: scoring rates and QB (~-0.1 each), in-season blend (-0.045), median target (-0.015 to -0.02, CI includes 0), divisional (-0.006 to -0.03), slope (~0).
changes.risk: PFF/Cole totals are untested (no history); coefficients assume nfelo Elo on the 25-Elo scale; applying QB_sum to QB-adjusted ratings double counts QB; the K=128 prior lags scoring-regime shifts (2022 ran -0.7); the Week-1 magnitude is LOW confidence (2010-21 alone is flat); a 2026 W1 QB series has one third the usual dispersion so the QB term contributes little in W1.

changes.area: Pace / play-style adjustments (totals and team totals)
changes.change: Delete the +/-1..2 pace adjustment on totals and set the pace, pass-rate/PROE and explosive-play/red-zone components of the team-total matchup reallocation to zero. One change covering both the totals and team-total uses so pace is not counted anywhere.
changes.parameter_spec: totals.pace_adj = 0; totals.style_adj (PROE / neutral pass rate) = 0; team_total.matchup_realloc explosive-play weight = 0, red-zone weight = 0, pace-mismatch weight = 0. Keep computing neutral sec/play, PROE and explosive rates weekly as diagnostics only, league-relative to the CURRENT season-to-date league mean once >= 64 team-games exist (prior-season mean before that), never mixing pbp sources inside a reference.
changes.evidence: Pace expert T1 / pace critic critic_01: spec bucket rule (+/-1.5 FF/SS, +/-0.75 mixed) on the market-free total OOS 2023-25 (n=752) +0.078 [+0.027,+0.125]; with a leak-free league reference +0.066 [+0.017,+0.110]; on the ratings-only total ORIGINATOR publishes +0.040 [-0.013,+0.087]; a same-size placebo noise rule costs +0.036 (sd 0.024). Totals critic rolling-origin on all pbp seasons (n=2592): +pace4 +0.019 [-0.032,+0.069], never helps. Upper bound: prior pace explains 1.4% of realized plays and plays explain 9.1% of market-residual variance, so pace can explain at most ~0.12% of residual variance; residual vs market pooled n=3194 slope -0.21 (se 0.19, p=0.27); the market itself prices pace at -0.28/s (2009-19) and -0.15/s (2023-25, p=0.09). Explosive plays (pace T2, teamtotals TT3b): offense x defense mismatch p=0.17-0.82 in every spec; rolling-origin reallocation makes the identity worse (home -0.019 [-0.039,+0.001], away -0.013 [-0.029,+0.004]); the 2023-25 'explosive offense' signal is one season (2024 +57, 2025 -0) and failed fit-2023-24 -> 2025 (+0.030 [-0.041,+0.104]). PROE (pace T3): residual vs market +0.044 (se 0.036) train, +0.022 test; market-free OOS +0.006 [-0.072,+0.083]; corr(PROE, market total) 0.50.
changes.expected_impact: Avoids +0.02 to +0.08 MAE on totals and +0.02 to +0.05 on team totals; no accuracy is given up (the 2013-19 pace effect was worth -0.01 and is gone or undetectable).
changes.risk: Era-dependent: pace had a small real effect in 2013-19 rolling-origin; power in 2023-25 is low (se 0.48 pts/s), so re-check the calibration slope after 2026 if pace dispersion widens. Diagnostics with a prior-season league reference inject 0.25-0.6 SD season offsets.

changes.area: Spread: PFF/Cole site HFA, time-zone term, neutral sites, rest and bye (one consolidated schedule/HFA change)
changes.change: Stop building the PFF/Cole site HFA from nfelo's hfa_mod (a composite of hfa_base + tz + div + surface + both bye mods) plus a second tz term; use a constant league HFA with a neutral-site override, strip nfelo's bye mods from the nfelo component, and price rest ONCE on the blended spread at the market's size. Delete the short-week, bye and west-to-east 10am clauses. This reconciles HFA-1/HFA-2/HFA-4 with schedule T2/T3/T4a/T6 so bye and tz are each counted exactly once.
changes.parameter_spec: PFF/Cole spread_i = -(R_home - R_away) - HFA_site, with HFA_site: location==Home -> 1.75 (band 1.5-2.0; no dome/outdoor split, no venue table, no Denver bump, no tz term; nfelo's hfa_base_mod/25, 1.67 for 2026, is an equivalent alternative); location==Neutral international (London/Germany/Mexico/Brazil/Spain/Ireland) -> 0.75; domestic neutral and Super Bowl -> 0.0. Never read hfa_mod or home_time_advantage_mod in these paths. nfelo component (ORIGINATOR sign, negative = home favored): line_nfelo = -nfelo_dif_base/25 + (home_bye_mod + away_bye_mod)/25 [note the PLUS: this removes nfelo's bye mods]; at location==Neutral also + home_time_advantage_mod/25 (zeroes nfelo's tz leak; hfa_base_mod is already 0 there). Rest term applied once to the blended spread after the blend and clamp: spread += -0.15 * clip(home_rest - away_rest, -7, +7) (home bye vs 7-day opponent = -1.05, i.e. 1.05 pts to the bye team; a 4-day vs 7-day gap = +0.45 to the rested side); Week 1 exempt (rest field is a placeholder). Delete section-5 'short week -0.6..-1.2', 'bye +0.5..+1.0' and 'west-to-east 10am kick -0.4..-0.8'. The 3-zone-traveller (+1.0 to the away team) and primetime-west (+1.0) flags are NOT parameters: log them as monitored research flags with a pre-registered stop rule (pooled 2026-27 traveller ATS <= 0.52).
changes.evidence: Synthesis 02: hfa_mod - (hfa_base + tz + div + surface + home_bye + away_bye) has sd 0.0000 (n=4646, 100% within 0.01 Elo); nfelo_dif_base = elo_dif + hfa_mod + qb in 95.7%; as-built (hfa_mod+tz)/25 has mean 2.25, sd 1.29 pts, embeds 0.58 pts of bye mod in home-bye games, and the blend then carries 0.46*0.34 + 0.54*0.58 + 0.75 = 1.22 pts for a home bye (schedule critic: 1.81 averaged over home and away byes) vs the market's 1.0. HFA critic rolling-origin 2015-25 n=2511: fixed 2.5 vs 1.75 +0.044 [+0.016,+0.073], 2.0 vs 1.75 +0.010 [+0.001,+0.020]; realized rating-adjusted HFA 2022-25 2.13 (CI 1.37-2.90), market-implied 1.55, market home residual mean +0.58 but median 0.00; dome vs outdoor Welch p=0.67; tz coefficient on outcomes -0.2 (se 1.3). Neutral (synthesis 02): 73 nfelo-joined neutral games, hfa_base_mod = 0 in all 73 but |tz| > 2.5 Elo in 44, mean |hfa_mod+tz|/25 = 0.84 pts; international edge 0.96 [-2.6,+4.7] (n=48), market 0.5. West-at-1pm (schedule T4a): home vs market -0.05 (se 0.77, n=383), spec -0.6 OOS +0.004; the effect existed 1999-2008 (+3.09, se 0.88) and vanished. Asymmetric short rest: n=8 in 2009-25, 0 since 2021.
changes.expected_impact: MAE-neutral within +/-0.02 (as-built vs 1.75: +0.023 [-0.038,+0.082]); removes ~1.3 pts SD of uncorrelated per-game noise from 54% of the spread blend, the 2x time-zone count and the bye double count (1.2-1.8 carried -> 1.05); bye-team bias on affected games +1.26 -> +0.40 OOS.

changes.area: QB starter->backup adjustment and its interaction with QB-adjusted inputs
changes.change: Replace the flat 'QB starter->backup -2.0..-4.5' with a stint-indexed penalty applied NET of what each rating input already embeds, keep nfelo's own QB term at full weight with no top-up, exempt planned offseason changes, and treat announced rested starters as a whole-roster event rather than a QB parameter.
changes.parameter_spec: P_stint (points, penalty on the team starting a less-experienced QB after an in-season change, known at publication): 1st start with the team this season 2.5 (band 2.0-3.0); 2nd-3rd start 1.5; 4th+ start 0.5 (0.5-1.0 defensible). QB_adj_spread = sum_i w_i * clip(P_stint - A_i, -1.0, P_stint), w = (0.46 nfelo, 0.39 PFF, 0.15 Cole). A_nfelo = 0.5*A_game + 0.5*A_stint, A_game = the backup team's FULL current 538 QB adj in points (-home_538_qb_adj/25 if home, +away_538_qb_adj/25 if away; nfelo_games.csv), A_stint = 2.3 / 1.6 / 0.8 by stint; if the nfelo input is the market-regressed close, A_nfelo = P (fully priced). A_PFF = A_Cole = P when the rating was published after the QB news (assumed QB-adjusted, unverified), else 0. QB_MOD_MULTIPLIER on nfelo's own term stays 1.0 (no 1.15-1.2 rescale). Never add the raw -2.0..-4.5 on top of the blend. Week 1 / offseason planned starters: new_QB_adj = 0, rookie_adj = 0, new_HC_adj = 0, and the backup downgrade is never applied to a planned offseason change. Announced rest by a playoff-locked team: whole-roster event with a market discount of ~9-9.5 pts (n=20-35): un-regressed nfelo share +0.46*(9.5-3.4) = +2.8, PFF/Cole share the full ~9 unless the rating post-dates the announcement, market-regressed input 0; preferred handling is to anchor to the market or not publish, tag LOW. Eliminated-team week 17-18 backups and playoff-game backups: ordinary stint value. Team-total split of the QB penalty 60/40 (unvalidated). The total counts toward the spread cap. WR1/OL/pass-rush spec values: keep, tag LOW (no local data).
changes.evidence: Synthesis 05 on the QB expert's prospective D3 events, in-season, one side only, fit 2009-21: market-implied penalty 2.66 (se 0.21, n=229) / 1.61 (0.18, n=263) / 0.62 (0.16, n=293) by stint; realized vs the no-QB line 2.76 (se 0.86, median 2.13) / 2.60 / 1.59 (median 0.55); nfelo already embeds 2.36 (median 2.17) / 1.67 / 0.79; residual after nfelo +0.40 (se 0.87) at stint 1 = fully priced. OOS 2022-25 stint 1 n=77: market 3.06, realized 5.76 (se 1.63), nfelo 2.05, residual after nfelo +3.71 (se 1.61) - watch item; stints 2-3 residual -0.70. QB critic: pre-event team-level gap +0.3-0.4 (events cluster after poor play) so the net stint-1 value is ~2.45; the displaced-starter conditional has zero qualifying events; rolling-origin 2016-25 on a no-QB line: stint table -0.044, recommended table 9.902 vs base 9.952, nfelo's continuous term 9.887 (best); x1.22 rescale worse (+0.017, 6/10 seasons). Calibration T4: nfelo QB term -0.113 [-0.209,-0.019] OOS, -0.55 in |qb|>=2 games (n=199), realized coefficient 1.24 [1.02,1.46]. Overshoot arithmetic: nfelo 2.36 + spec 3.0 = 5.4 vs market 2.7 on ~7% of games. Week 1 (earlyseason 4b critic): +2.13 (se 0.98) is definition-sensitive (+0.07 vs last-game starter), carried by n=93 'took over last season' incumbents, and a +1.0 lean is worth -0.11 [-0.25,+0.03]; no definition gives a negative point estimate, so a backup downgrade on planned changes is contradicted. Rest games (QB critic critic_03): true rest n=20 market 8.88 (se 1.21), realized 11.38, nfelo 3.44; broader proxy n=35 market 9.54 (se 0.70), vs market +1.74 (se 2.00, p=0.39); synthesis 05 late-week stint-1 n=49: market 5.64, realized 10.33, nfelo 3.32 (a mixture of rest and eliminated-team starts).
changes.expected_impact: Prevents a 2-4.5 pt overshoot on ~7% of games (about -0.02 MAE overall, larger on affected games); the stint table is worth -0.05 MAE [-0.087,-0.014] on inputs that carry no QB term; no ATS edge vs the close is claimed (backup-fade ATS 51.5%).
changes.risk: Realized penalties are right-skewed (fit-window median 1.6-2.4); the 2023-25 first-start residual (+3.7, n=75-77) may signal under-pricing but needs ~150 events; PFF/Cole QB-adjustment status and timing are unverified; per-game A is noisy (hence the 50% shrink); the rest-game discount is precisely measured but n<150 (LOW).

changes.area: Team totals: identity only, reallocation block zeroed, spread coherence
changes.change: Derive team totals strictly from the final adjusted spread and total via the identity; set the +/-0.5..1.5 matchup reallocation to a default of 0 with a hard +/-0.5 cap, and require any sum-preserving delta to be mirrored into the published spread.
changes.parameter_spec: home_tt = T/2 - S/2, away_tt = T/2 + S/2 (S in ORIGINATOR sign, negative = home favored; T and S are the FINAL numbers after all QB, injury, weather, rest adjustments). matchup_realloc: default 0; if used discretionarily, |delta| <= 0.5 and spread_final = spread - 2*delta (else reject). No favorite/dog nonlinearity, no home-share term, no median/skew shade at low team totals, no explosive/red-zone/pace/PF-PA profile reallocation. Rounding to .0/.5 with sum preserved unchanged.
changes.evidence: Teamtotals TT1 (critic reproduced): OLS slopes home S -0.517 (se 0.021) T +0.466 (0.025), away +0.524 / +0.453; Wald slope=identity p=0.27 home / 0.07 away; rolling-origin 2010-25 n=4363 identity better than nonlinear OLS by 0.014 home / 0.020 away (season-block CI away [-0.035,-0.004]; modern-only 12/12 seasons on away); Huber slopes closer to the identity. TT2: home allocation asymmetry -0.003 pts (CI [-0.17,+0.16]). TT1b: low team-total shade helps only in-sample 1999-2021, hurts 2022-25 (-0.079 [-0.167,+0.024] for a -0.5 shade). TT3a/TT3b: PF/PA and pbp reallocations explain <0.6% of residual variance and make the identity worse in rolling-origin (home -0.018 [-0.036,-0.000]; pbp home -0.019 [-0.039,+0.001]); future-feature placebo (+1.1 to +1.3 pts/SD) proves the pipeline can detect a real effect. TT4: random U(0.5,1.5) reallocation costs +0.043 MAE (2022-25, n=1139) and +0.048 (2010-21, n=3224); break-even true shift = half the reallocation; coherence |(home_tt - away_tt) + S| = 0 exactly. TT5: the 7-9.5 favorite bin's +1.1 mean is blowout skew (favorites 47.7% ATS in the bin 2010-25, 41.7% in 2022-25); no rule clears zero.
changes.expected_impact: Avoids +0.02 to +0.09 MAE per team total from noise reallocations and removes hidden spread changes of up to 3 pts; the split itself is already optimal.
changes.risk: No market team totals exist locally, so the benchmark is the identity on the market close; validated context adjustments (QB, WR1) enter via S and T and are out of scope here.
changes.source_theories: teamtotals TT1 (UPHELD), TT1b (UPHELD), TT2 (UPHELD), TT3a (UPHELD), TT3b (UPHELD), TT4 (UPHELD), TT5 (DOWNGRADED); pace T2 (UPHELD)

changes.area: Confidence tags, per-game sigma, edge accounting and benchmark line
changes.change: Replace the inter-engine-SD confidence tags (spread 1.2/2.2, totals 1.8/3.0) with distance-to-market bands documented as expected excess RMSE vs the close, publish a per-game sigma from a single seasonal base, and account for edges with shrinkage instead of point gaps or key-number EV.
changes.parameter_spec: D_spread = |published spread - latest market spread|, D_total = |published total - latest market total|. Tags (initial cuts; recalibrate to ~55/30/15 shares on ORIGINATOR's own D distribution after four weeks - a blend with independent engines will put 20-35% in LOW and needs cuts near 1.75/3.5): spread HIGH D<1.5, MED 1.5-3.0, LOW >=3.0; total HIGH <2.5, MED 2.5-5.0, LOW >=5.0. Each tag is labeled 'expected excess RMSE vs the close = sqrt(BASE^2 + D^2) - BASE' (spread D=1.5 +0.09, D=3 +0.35, D=5 +0.96), never 'confidence' or 'edge'. Forced LOW: final regular-season week; games with an announced rested starter. sigma_spread(g) = sqrt(12.65^2 + D^2), sigma_total(g) = sqrt(13.1^2 + D_tot^2), BASE = RMSE of the market's own error over the last 5 seasons (any 3-8 season window is within 0.1), recomputed each August; against an OPENER use D = 0. Interval half-widths: spread 0.60/1.24/1.61 x sigma, total 0.66/1.26/1.62 x sigma for 50/80/90%. No modifiers for engine SD, favorite size, total size, roof, week, Week 1 or pace; inter-engine SD may be shown only as an 'engine agreement' diagnostic. No disagreement-dependent market weight (no w(D)); if the engine is ever blended with the close use a constant w <= 0.3 (w = 0 was best in 2022-25). Edge accounting: keep point-distance thresholds computed on the UNROUNDED origin; treat only lambda ~0.27 of an origin-vs-market gap as real (break-even needs ~3 pts raw gap); use the landing-mass table only for push probability (m_3 ~0.10 recent era, m_7 ~0.06, generic 0.02-0.03) and for pricing half points against a MARKET number; no mass-table EV threshold, no -3/-7 guard, no steam lean; benchmark against the latest available line, never the opener (the close beats the open 54.5% ATS).
changes.evidence: Synthesis 04 (2022-25 REG n=1087, unregressed nfelo line): |market err| ~ D slope -0.004 (se 0.171, p=0.98), Spearman +0.027; |model err| ~ D +0.394 (se 0.181, p=0.029); corr(e_mkt, model - mkt) +0.036, so model RMSE = sqrt(mkt RMSE^2 + D^2) by identity; bands (1.5,3.0) shares 0.54/0.31/0.15 with excess RMSE +0.03/+0.11/+1.42 vs identity +0.03/+0.19/+0.80; BASE 2021-25 spread 12.63, total 13.08 (2023-25 12.65/12.96; 2019-25 12.73/13.10); season RMSE 11.4-14.3 with lag-1 autocorrelation -0.05 (critic). Uncertainty expert/critic: literal SD cuts sort games into market RMSE 12.48/12.21/12.71 (LOW/HIGH ratio 1.04, p=0.37), engine SD pooled slope -0.04/pt (p=0.73), LOW/HIGH outcome-sigma ratio bounded to 0.98-1.09; joint F-test of all candidate modifiers on |market err| p=0.71 (n=4310); coverage 0.51/0.80/0.88 spread and 0.50/0.81/0.91 total OOS; w(D) rule +0.006 [-0.021,+0.032], every positive market weight hurt 2022-25 (w=0.5 +0.071, p=0.028); c=0 vs the opener as good as 0.5. Calibration T2/T3: a market-blind nfelo number loses 0.238 [0.119,0.364] MAE to the close, 49.5% ATS since 2022 (55.7% only in 2014-18); |qbelo - nfelo| has zero relation to anyone's |error| (p>0.48). Market T4 critic: rolling-origin Elo origin lambda 0.273 (se 0.089), origin-side cover 51.4-52.7% at every gap, 'act when EV>=0.02' fires on 59% of games at 51.1% cover and -1.0% ROI; crossed-mass never adds beyond the gap (b=-0.57, p=0.54); +3 dogs 55.8/53.3/49.0% by era; m_3 0.069 -> 0.091 -> 0.108. Market T2: with-steam ATS 50.4-51.2% beyond the close, ROI -0.9% to -2.6% at actual prices; close beats the open 56-60%. Schedule T5b critic: final-week market-vs-ratings gap 2.90 vs 1.75 (p<0.001) justifies LOW; the 0.25/0.75 close blend is test-era only and leaks the close.
changes.expected_impact: No change to any number; stops the tags from being read as outcome uncertainty or edge (they measured engine agreement, p>0.3 everywhere) and prevents ~59% of games being flagged as +EV by a key-number rule that returns -1% ROI.
changes.risk: Band shares and cut points are engine-specific and must be recalibrated on the live blend; lambda for the actual ORIGINATOR blend is unknown (between 0.27 for an unregressed rating and 0.73 for nfelo's regressed close); the identity over-predicts excess RMSE whenever the engine has any edge vs the reference line.
changes.source_theories: uncertainty T1a (DOWNGRADED), T1b (DOWNGRADED), T2 (DOWNGRADED), T3 (UPHELD), T4 (DOWNGRADED); calibration T2 (DOWNGRADED), T3 (UPHELD); market T1 (UPHELD), T2 (UPHELD), T3 (DOWNGRADED), T4 (DOWNGRADED), T5 (UPHELD); schedule T5b (DOWNGRADED, LOW tag only), T5a (UPHELD); earlyseason 1b (UPHELD)

changes.change: Tighten the cap on the sum of section-5 context adjustments in Week 1 only and do not pull the Week-1 number more than halfway toward a market gap; leave rating weights, scale, HFA and tags unchanged in Week 1.
changes.parameter_spec: Week 1 only: cap on the SUM of section-5 context adjustments 2.0 pts spread (from 2.5) and 2.5 pts total (from 3.0); no per-adjustment scaling; Weeks 2+ unchanged at 2.5/3.0 (no Week 2-4 caps). Week 1: rating multiplier k = 1.00, rating weights 0.46/0.39/0.15 and 25 Elo/pt unchanged, site HFA unchanged (optional -0.5 haircut NOT adopted), confidence-tag cuts unchanged, no home/favorite/underdog term.
changes.evidence: Earlyseason 1a/2 (critic upheld): regressed preseason ratings match the close in Week 1 (elo_line MAE 9.79 vs market 9.82, diff -0.03 [-0.31,+0.23], n=253; hindsight-free placebo rating shows the same pattern, +0.195 [-0.13,+0.52]); W1 shrink k = 0.94 with MAE gain -0.029 [-0.08,+0.03] and worse RMSE, k with intercept 1.016; nfelo's W1 rating carries 40.4% of prior-season MOV vs an outcome-optimal 43.6% (se 9.9%); 2026 PFF/Cole W1 dispersions (3.74 / 3.17-3.29) sit inside the outcome-supported band (2.4-4.7). Earlyseason 5b (DOWNGRADED): information beyond ratings is worth 0.41 (se 0.35) of face value in W1 and the W1-4 change is -0.40 (cluster p=0.039), but era-unstable (1.12 in 2009-14 vs -0.14 in 2015-25) and the pooled significance rides on Week 3; rolling-origin cap W1 -0.09 [-0.27,+0.08], W5+ caps hurt +0.13..+0.23 (p<0.01); W1 residual SD 12.97 vs 13.13 (no widening). Earlyseason 1b/5a: W1 home residual -0.70 [-1.94,+0.55], dog ATS 0.527 (p=0.30), W1 HFA shift -1.04 (se 0.84, p=0.22).
changes.expected_impact: Negligible on MAE; prevents over-adjusting the ~20-25% of Week-1 games where |market - ratings| > 2.5 with news-driven terms that carry roughly half their face value early in the season.
changes.risk: LOW confidence: the effect is unstable across eras and not significant in rolling-origin; tests use nfelo's regressed preseason ratings only (PFF/Cole W1 behaviour is unvalidated).

changes.area: Optional totals efficiency term from play-by-play (EPA), replacing the deleted pace term
changes.change: If the weekly pbp pipeline exists, add a small, capped EPA/play efficiency term to the market-free total; otherwise skip. Do not stack any pace term on it.
changes.parameter_spec: totals.eff_adj = clip(3.0 * epa_sum_dev, -2.0, +2.0) (4.0 with cap +/-3 is the point-estimate-optimal alternative, wider CI), epa_sum_dev = (h_epa_off + a_epa_off + h_epa_def + a_epa_def) - 4*league_mean, each from the team's prior 8 games (min 4; before 4 games fall back to prior-season team mean then league mean), league_mean = current season-to-date league EPA/play once >= 64 team-games exist (prior-season mean before that), never crossing a pbp-source change. Applied on top of the priority-1 formula. Fallback if EPA is unavailable: points per drive with the same construction. pace_adj remains 0. Optional team-total term tt_adj = clip(4.0*off_epa_dev, -1, +1) is NOT adopted (calibration 0.72 +/- 0.51).
changes.evidence: Pace T4 / pace critic critic_04, critic_06: pooled rolling-origin over all 10 pbp test seasons (2013-19, 2023-25; n=2381) refit +epa -0.049 [-0.092,-0.007] (6/7 pre-2020 and 2/3 modern seasons better); fixed clip(3*epa,+/-2) -0.024 [-0.046,-0.002] (7/10 seasons), clip(4*epa,+/-3) -0.029 [-0.057,+0.001]; leak-free OOS 2023-25 (n=752) -0.033 [-0.070,+0.004] / -0.039 [-0.089,+0.011]; 2023-25 in-sample coefficient +5.67 (se 3.23, p=0.079), calibration slope 0.58 (se 0.39); single-season coefficients positive in 11/14 seasons, inverse-variance pooled +5.73 (se 1.66); recency placebo (prior-8 points for/against) -0.009 [-0.047,+0.031] and EPA stays significant jointly (+5.2, p=0.013); the market prices EPA at the realized rate (+6.5 to +7.9 vs realized +5.7 to +6.7) so the term moves the number toward the close (MAE vs market 2.13 -> 1.96). Contrary construction: totals critic critic_06 with a K=6 season-blend EPA on the full spec +0.003 [-0.020,+0.026]. The 54.6% O/U claim does not survive (always-over 51.1%, flipped picks 54-37, p=0.09).
changes.expected_impact: -0.02 to -0.03 MAE on the market-free total (CI touches zero); a market-consistency term, not an O/U edge; mean |adj| ~0.6 pts.
changes.risk: Construction-sensitive (prior-8 window with a season-to-date reference helps, a season-blend does not); winner's-curse selection among 11 candidates; never tested on 2020-22 (pbp missing); requires a weekly pbp feed and a leak-free league reference.
changes.source_theories: pace T4 (DOWNGRADED); totals T2 EPA finding (DOWNGRADED)

keep_as_is: ELO_PER_POINT = 25 with a linear mapping and no hinge/shrink for big favorites: pooled OLS slope 1.035 [0.974,1.097], median slope 0.959 [0.886,1.033], every era CI contains 1; bins 7-10/10-14/14+ realized/projected 0.98/1.03/1.00; alternative scales 24-28 move OOS MAE by <=0.025 with CIs including 0, OLS-scaling is significantly worse in rolling-origin (+0.013 [0.002,0.025]); a results-only Elo also calibrates at 25/pt (slope 1.003 +/- 0.067). (calibration T1 UPHELD)

QB_MOD_MULTIPLIER = 1.0 on nfelo's own QB term (points = home_net_qb_mod/25): -0.113 MAE OOS [-0.209,-0.019], -0.12 rolling 2013-25, realized coefficient 1.24 [1.02,1.46]; a 1.1-1.3 multiplier buys <=0.005 MAE and the x1.22 rescale is worse in rolling-origin. (calibration T4 UPHELD; qb-2a UPHELD)

Structural clamp k = 4.5 (PFF pulled to nfelo +/- 4.5), untuned: the clamp's sign is set purely by which engine is more accurate (clamping a weaker engine -0.019, p=0.06; clamping the better one +0.032, p=0.005; symmetric +0.002; market-as-X placebo +0.018, p=0.009), so it is at most +/-0.02 MAE insurance; thresholds 3/4.5/6 are indistinguishable; the engine weight, not the clamp, is the lever and cannot be set without PFF history. (calibration T3 UPHELD as inconclusive)

No market term inside the spread formula (spec rule): the OOS-optimal weight on a rating number vs the close was ~0.25 pre-2019 and ~0 in 2022-25 (w=0.3 costs +0.030, w=0.5 +0.071, p=0.028); only informational constants change (see change 7). (calibration T2 DOWNGRADED, uncertainty T3 UPHELD)

Spread blend weights 0.46 nfelo / 0.39 PFF / 0.15 Cole and the totals blend .38/.32/.30: no PFF/Cole history exists locally, so no evidence to change them; note the double-count caveat in open questions. Do not down-weight ratings in Weeks 1-4 (ratings match the close in W1-4 and only fall behind from W10+, +0.22 [+0.11,+0.32]). (earlyseason 1a UPHELD)

Half-up rounding to .0/.5 for spreads and totals, no key-number logic: the 2.75/6.75 round-down tweak is ~0.1% of EV on ~8% of games and a placebo at non-key x.75 numbers shows equal or larger 'gains' (5.75 +0.015, 9.75 +0.030); totals key numbers 41/44/47/51 carry 4.2% vs 2.7% mass, worth ~3 cents per half point, rounding EV differences indistinguishable from placebo (MW p=0.51). (market T3 DOWNGRADED, T5 UPHELD)

No segment shading of spreads or totals (favorite size, home/away favorite, primetime, divisional, Week 1, playoffs, total size, roof): 0 of 47 segment biases survive Holm/BH; per-season sign consistency max 12/17; vig-free implied probabilities 0.500 +/- 0.01 in every segment. (market T1 UPHELD)

No steam lean; benchmark against the latest line: beyond the close OLS +0.04 (p=0.70), with-steam ATS 50.4-51.2%, ROI -0.9% to -2.6% at actual prices; vs the OPEN the close's side wins 56-60%. (market T2 UPHELD)

No slot/primetime/Thanksgiving/Week-1 HFA, no team or venue HFA table, no Denver bump, no dome/outdoor HFA split: slot deviations flip sign between windows (SNF +3.0 fit -> -1.0 test) and rolling-origin slot coefficients raise MAE (+0.014); team HFA split-half r 0.21-0.27 with OOS MAE +0.002; dome vs outdoor Welch p=0.67; Denver market residual +1.52 (se 1.21), home cover 0.513. (hfa HFA-2 DOWNGRADED, HFA-3 UPHELD)

No divisional spread adjustment or margin compression: div HFA difference -0.51 (p=0.25) with a sign flip fit->test, rating slope x div +0.02 (se 0.08), rolling-origin div-specific HFA no value (10.080 vs 10.079); nfelo's internal -1.05 div mod is unsupported but not significant enough to counter-adjust. (hfa HFA-5 spread part UPHELD)

No wind or weather term on spreads and no spread-confidence change in wind: favorite cover margin at >=15 mph -1.2 in-sample (p=0.05) but +2.1 OOS (n=60), margin ~ spread x wind interaction p=0.53/0.59, spread MAE flat across wind bins. (totals T3c UPHELD)

No TNF totals/variance term, no Week-1 shrink of the rating line (k = 1.00), no Week-1 home/favorite/dog term, no new-head-coach adjustment: TNF total residual +0.35 (se 0.87, n=241; +0.51 on n=300); W1 k loss curve flat 0.8-1.1; W1 home residual -0.70 [-1.94,+0.55]; new HC -0.18 (se 1.11, n=412 games), ATS 0.493. (schedule T1b UPHELD, earlyseason 1b/2/4a UPHELD)

No PROE / pass-rate / explosive-play / pace term anywhere (covered in change 3) and no offense/defense split coefficients in totals (pf 0.34 vs pa 0.27, Wald p=0.41-0.51, identical OOS MAE). (totals T1b UPHELD, pace T1-T3 UPHELD)

No disagreement-dependent model weight w(D) and no engine-SD-based anything: in-sample w(D) = 0.78 - 0.08D (p=0.007) reversed OOS (+0.006 [-0.021,+0.032] vs constant); with the real pre-regression nfelo line w1 = +0.002 (p=0.96). (uncertainty T3 UPHELD)

Neutral/international HFA constants 0.75 international / 0.0 domestic neutral and Super Bowl (spec defaults): designated-home edge 0.79-0.96 with CI [-2.7,+4.7] (n=48-52), market prices 0.5; only the pass-through of nfelo's tz term is removed (change 4). (hfa HFA-4 UPHELD as inconclusive)
Team-total identity coefficients 0.5/-0.5 and 0.5/+0.5 with zero intercept, no home share, no median shade (covered in change 6). (teamtotals TT1/TT1b/TT2 UPHELD)

The 2.5-pt spread / 3.0-pt total context-adjustment caps in Weeks 2+ (the schedule expert's |sum| <= 2.0 cap was asserted without evidence and is not adopted; W5+ caps of any size on the market gap hurt +0.13..+0.23). (schedule T6 DOWNGRADED, earlyseason 5b DOWNGRADED)
rejected_theories: Elo->points mapping is non-linear / needs a big-favorite shrink or expand (calibration T1): hinge terms p=0.85/0.77 in train and opposite-signed OOS; x1.10 at |proj|>=7 costs +0.084 MAE (p=0.005).
A shrinkage blend with the market beats the close (calibration T2): train-optimal w=0.25 applied OOS +0.022 [-0.009,+0.056]; w=0 best in 2022-25; nfelo's edge vs the close existed only in 2014-18.

Large inter-engine disagreement identifies the wrong engine, so the clamp should be tightened or tuned (calibration T3): beta on the deviating engine flips sign train/test, |gap| has zero relation to anyone's error (p>0.48).
Team/venue-specific HFA including Denver (HFA-2): tau 0.67 fit -> 0.00 test, team corr r=0.21, OOS MAE +0.002; Denver home cover 0.513.
Kickoff-slot and Week-1 HFA (HFA-3, earlyseason 5a): slot effects reverse OOS and raise rolling-origin MAE; W1 shift -1.04 (se 0.84, p=0.22).
Divisional games have lower HFA / compressed margins (HFA-5 spread): -0.51 (p=0.25) with a sign flip; interaction +0.02 (se 0.08).

Constant 46.0 is 'wrong' because of the slope 0.35 (totals T1a as stated): the level mechanism already is the prior-season mean; slope 0.35 vs 0.28 is worth -0.006 [-0.027,+0.017]; only the in-season blend and median target carry value (adopted in change 1).
Separate offense and defense weights are needed in totals (T1b split): pf 0.34 vs pa 0.27, p=0.41-0.51.
Cold <32F lowers totals beyond wind (T3b): -0.10 (se 0.93) with stadium FE; precipitation -1.5 is sized on the test period and unvalidated.
Wind should shade spreads toward the underdog (T3c): -1.2 in-sample, +2.1 OOS (n=60), interaction p=0.53.

Favorites score more than the identity at big spreads / home teams get a larger share / low team totals should be shaded to the median / PF-PA and pbp matchups justify +/-0.5..1.5 reallocations (TT1, TT2, TT1b, TT3a, TT3b): every fitted alternative is worse OOS and reallocation noise costs +0.04 MAE.
Favorite 7-9.5 bin deserves a 0.5 favorite lean or a team-total bump (TT5): favorites 47.7% ATS in the bin 2010-25 (41.7% in 2022-25); the +1 mean is blowout skew.

A conditional stint-1 penalty keyed to the displaced starter's nfelo adj (>= +3 -> 3.5) and a 1.15-1.2 rescale of nfelo's QB term (qb-1): zero qualifying events, slope opposite-signed (-0.29, p=0.04); the rescale is worse in rolling-origin (+0.017).

A 5.0-pt 'rested starter' QB rule (qb-2b OVERTURNED): the 59-game sample is 20 true rest games (market discount 8.9, se 1.2) plus 25 eliminated-team and 14 injury starts; the +4.6 residual vs market comes from the eliminated-team subgroup and does not replicate (+12.6 -> +2.6).

Week-1 new-starter / rookie adjustment in either direction (qb-3, earlyseason 4b): +2.1 (p=0.03) is definition-sensitive (+0.07 vs last-game starter), carried by n=93 mid-season takeovers, and a +1.0 lean is worth -0.11 [-0.25,+0.03]; Bonferroni p 0.15-0.43.
Standalone short-week clause (schedule T1a): asymmetric short rest occurs in 8 games in 17 seasons, 0 since 2021; TNF both-short games show nothing (T1b).
West-to-east 10am kick penalty (T4a): PT/MT teams at 1pm ET run -0.05 vs the market (se 0.77, n=383); the effect existed in 1999-2008 and has been priced since 2009.

A 3-zone travel penalty (T4b) and, as parameters, the reverse +1.0 traveller flag and the +1.0 primetime-west flag (T4b/T4c): no dose-response (2-zone games run the opposite way, +1.30 home, p=0.03), absent 2009-17, MAE CIs include 0; kept as monitored research flags only.

Week-1 shrink to the market / wider W1 tags (T5a) and the final-week 0.25 model / 0.75 close blend (T5b): W1 engine-minus-market +0.03 (se 0.13); the final-week rule is a 2021+ test-era finding, leaks the closing line (|close-open| 1.9 vs 1.0-1.2), and is a special case of 'the market beats the engine everywhere' (fit-set optimal engine weight 0.2-0.3 in ALL weeks); only the LOW tag survives.
The closing line misses systematically in identifiable segments (market T1): 0 of 47 survive multiplicity; placebo segments produce as many p<0.05 hits.
Lean with open-to-close steam (market T2): 50.4-51.2% beyond the close, negative ROI at actual prices; the 2024-25 totals fade (56.4%) is two seasons and one feed - monitor only.
Key-number-aware rounding of x.75 below 3/7 (market T3): +0.014 EV in one cell, matched or beaten by placebo cells at 5.75/8.75/9.75, negative in 2022-25.

Probability-space EV thresholds from the landing-mass table with a -3/-7 guard (market T4 operational part): assumes lambda=1 when rolling-origin lambda is 0.27; 'act when EV>=0.02' fires on 59% of games at 51.1% cover, -1.0% ROI; crossed mass adds nothing beyond the gap (p=0.54); the guard cell reversed sign in 2022-25.
Totals key numbers 41/44/47/51 warrant key-aware rounding (market T5): key vs non-key rounding EV +0.0014 vs -0.0032, MW p=0.51; individual key ranks unstable across eras.

Engine disagreement predicts market error / thresholds 1.2-2.2 and 1.8-3.0 separate error levels / disagreement identifies who is right (uncertainty T1a, T2, T3): market |err| slope on D -0.004 (p=0.98), LOW/HIGH variance ratio 0.98-1.09, engine SD pooled slope -0.04 (p=0.73); w(D) reversed OOS.

A trailing-3-season sigma base tracks meaningful drift (uncertainty T4 detail): between-season true SD 0.51 with lag-1 autocorrelation -0.05; any 3-8 season window is within 0.1; c=0.5 vs the opener is unsupported (rolling c_hat = 0 in 5/10 years).
Fast/fast vs slow/slow pace matchups warrant +/-1..2 on totals (pace T1): spec rule +0.078 [+0.027,+0.125] OOS (leak-free +0.066), placebo-level; upper bound ~0.12% of residual variance.
Explosive offense vs leaky defense justifies team-total reallocation (pace T2): mismatch p=0.17-0.82 everywhere; the 2023-25 offense effect is 2024 only and failed in 2025.
PROE / pass rate is a totals signal (pace T3): residual vs market +0.044 (se 0.036); market corr 0.50; OOS +0.006 [-0.072,+0.083].

Preseason ratings are less predictive in Weeks 1-4 and should be down-weighted/hedged/shrunk (earlyseason 1a, 2): ratings match the close in W1 (diff -0.03 [-0.31,+0.23]) and fall behind only from W10+; k=1.016 with intercept.
Week-1 market biases (home/favorite/dog/totals over) are exploitable (earlyseason 1b): all within +/-0.8 pts with CIs spanning 0; W1 unders 54.7% [49.8,59.5].
New head coach mispricing (earlyseason 4a): -0.18 (se 1.11), ATS 0.493; a W5+ underperformance (-0.53, se 0.31) is inconclusive.
Totals-size-dependent SD widening for lines >= 53.5 (market T1 optional): n=194 and OOS Spearman 0.02-0.04 (p>=0.17) in the uncertainty expert's test.
open_questions: PFF and Kevin Cole have NO local history (only 2026 W1 snapshots), so the 0.46/0.39/0.15 spread weights, the 0.38/0.32/0.30 totals weights, the clamp anchor rule (which engine has the lower trailing-3-season MAE), the PFF/Cole totals formula (are their ratings QB-adjusted? on what points scale?), their Week-1 behaviour, their distance-to-market band shares and their shrinkage lambda are all untested. Needed: archived weekly PFF power ratings and Cole power/betting ratings back to at least 2018, with publication timestamps relative to QB news.

nfelo's Elo is market-, PFF-, WEPA- and win-total-informed by construction (greerreNFL/nfelo config: market_resist_factor 1.5039, pff_weight 0.1113, wepa_weight 0.1506, wt_ratings_weight 0.4496; empirically the per-game update pulls ratings -3.1 Elo per point of line disagreement). Consequences to resolve: the blend double-counts PFF; 'no market input' claims need a footnote; the 0.24 MAE loss vs the close is a floor (a results-only Elo loses 0.37-0.43). Needed: a market-blind rating series (results-only Elo with canonical parameters, or archived PFF) to measure the true blend value and the true lambda.

Non-QB injury adjustments (WR1 -0.5..-1.5 TT, OL/pass-rush -1..-2 TT and -0.5..-1.5 spread) cannot be validated: no injury, depth-chart, snap-count or status columns exist in any local file. Needed: nflverse injuries/depth charts/snap counts 2009-2025 (releases are egress-blocked here).

Rested-starter games (playoff-locked team sits its QB): the market discount is ~9-9.5 pts (n=20-35, se 0.7-1.2) and nfelo carries only ~3.4, but n is far below 150 and the rest classification uses whether the starter started the next playoff game (diagnostic, not prospective). Needed: standings/clinch flags and announced-starter timestamps back to 2009 to build a prospective rule; also whether the discount is a QB effect or whole-roster.

The 2023-25 first-backup-start residual after nfelo's QB term (+3.7, se 1.6, n=75-77; likely-injury subgroup +4.6) may indicate under-pricing in the modern era; ~150 events are needed (re-test after 2026). Related: benching-driven changes (market +3.35 vs realized +1.07, n=59) vs injury-driven ones look different but are inconclusive.

The wind and cold effects were measured on game-time realized weather; the engine will use forecasts, so the usable slope is smaller by an unmeasured forecast-reliability factor, and 2022 lacks observed wind for ~49% of outdoor games. Needed: archived pre-game forecasts (wind, temperature, precipitation) 2009-2025; precipitation exists only as 2023-25 text strings.

2020-2022 play-by-play is missing locally (nflverse egress-blocked), so every pbp feature (pace, EPA, PROE, explosive rates) is untested on those seasons and the EPA term's coefficient was never checked on 2022; the EPA gain is construction-sensitive (prior-8 window -0.03 vs season-blend +0.003). Needed: 2020-22 pbp and a pre-registered construction before adopting change 9.

Divisional totals: the 'divisional under' is partly a late-season NON-divisional over (weeks 14-18 market residual +2.00, n=496, vs -0.19 for divisional games in the same weeks); the mean-preserving DIV term is a model-calibration fix, and the late-season pattern deserves its own test (rest/motivation/weather pricing).

Monitored research flags with pre-registered stop rules, not parameters: 3-zone traveller edge (2018-25 8/8 seasons, traveller ATS 0.585, but 2-zone games run the opposite way; stop if pooled 2026-27 traveller ATS <= 0.52), primetime more-western team (+1.5-1.7 vs market, 14/17 seasons, no dose-response), 2024-25 totals steam fade (56.4%, one opener feed), SNF HFA (+1.9 pooled, p=0.04, negative in 2022-25), the week-18-era final-week engine deficit (+0.97 vs +0.22 in other weeks, 2021-25 only), and the 'took over last season' incumbent QB effect (+3.3, n=93).

kit.py join bug: games.gid rewrites only _LAR_/_OAK_, so 317 REG games in 2009-2019 (all involving STL/SD/LAC/LA/OAK/LV ids) silently lose Elo/QB in every expert's fit window (coverage 0.928 -> 1.000 after normalizing both id parts; the 2022-25 test set is unaffected). Fix kit.py (gid = season_week_norm(away)_norm(home)) and refit the fit-window numbers; coefficients moved by less than one se where the totals critic checked.
